    customer_key,
    MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date

body.value: The answer, read off the two rows the query returned: what Contoso took in calendar 2024, after discount, split by when the customer first ever bought. Customers whose first-ever purchase predates 2024 brought in 18,589,446.72 US dollars — 8,119 of those 41,392 long-standing customers ordered that year, while the other 33,273 bought nothing and contribute zero. Customers whose first-ever purchase fell in 2024 brought in 13,050,244.21, from all 5,932 of them. The older group leads by 5,539,202.51, a 58.75% / 41.25% split of the year's 31,639,690.93, and the two rows together exhaust 2024 — nothing booked that year sits outside them. NOT included: anything either group spent in any other year; the 4,865 customers who first bought in 2025, who made no 2024 purchase; the 52,801 registered people who have never bought; and any gross-before-discount reading. Both channels are in both rows, shops and web shop alike, and an order counts in the year it was placed, not delivered.
